Settle a visit’s pending accepted edit before close, replacement by open, submission, or disposal returns, so a later visit restores persisted text and submission retains its entry snapshot. Keep the public and injected interfaces synchronous, preserve supported queue and confirmation behavior, and leave the adjacent search preview outside this change. The reported defect is writing on every keystroke, not writing edits at all.
